operations.summary: Read the persisted node configuration sync isolation states in the current scope
operations.summary_zh: 查询当前作用域内持久化的节点配置同步隔离状态

params.name: node_id
params.description: Repeatable; omitted returns every existing isolation state in the current scope.
params.description_zh: 可重复；省略时返回当前作用域内全部已有隔离状态事实。

responses.description: States are sorted by node ID; nodes without a state are not in the result.
responses.description_zh: 状态按节点 ID 稳定排序；没有状态事实的节点不在结果中。

responses.description: Stable error code; the UI must map it by locale and must not show message directly.
responses.description_zh: 稳定错误码；界面必须按 locale 映射，不得直接展示 message。
